tableQuery.query:
select 
	b.maiadt as "日历日期",
	b.caln_week as "日历周几", 
	b.caln_mon as "日历月份", 
	b.caln_quarter as "日历季度", 
	b.caln_year as "日历年份", 
	b.channel_brand_code as "渠道品牌编码", 
	b.channel_brand as "渠道品牌", 
	st.brand_large_area as "品牌大区",
	st.region_code				AS	"区域编码",
	st.region					AS	"区域",
	b.store_depot_code as "店仓编码",
	b.store_depot_name as  "店仓名称",
   case when st.oper_type in ('直营店','联营店','自营店') then '店'
          else '仓' end    as "店仓标记",
	st.province					AS	"省份",
	st.city						AS	"城市",
	st.city_lvl					AS	"城市等级",
   st.store_categ_name       as "店铺类型",
	st.store_type_dtl			AS	"店铺类型明细",
	st.store_lvl					AS	"店铺等级",
	st.oper_type					AS	"经营类型",
	st.market_system				AS	"商场体系",
	st.market_name				AS	"商场名称",
	st.open_store_dt				AS	"开店日期",
	st.close_store_dt			AS	"闭店日期",
	gd.good_brand_code			AS	"商品品牌编码",
	gd.good_brand				AS	"商品品牌",
	gd.big_class				AS	"大类",
	gd.mid_class				AS	"中类",
	gd.small_class				AS	"小类",
	gd.prop						AS	"属性",
	gd.top_bottom				AS	"上下装",
	gd.biz_type					AS	"业务类型",
	gd.imc_type					AS	"IMC类型",
	gd.series					AS	"主题",
	gd.sub_series				AS	"故事包",
	gd.prd_year					AS	"产品年",
	gd.prd_quarter				AS	"产品季",
	gd.prd_year_quarter			AS	"产品年季",
	gd.delivery_quarter			AS	"配货季",
	gd.fashion_num				AS	"款号",
	b.art_no					AS	"货号",
    gd.pic_url                   AS  "图片",
	gd.good_name				AS	"商品名称",
	gd.ipo_dt					AS	"上市日期",
   datediff('day',gd.ipo_dt,toDate(now())) as "上市天数",
   toString(datediff('day',gd.ipo_dt,toDate(now()))) as "上市天数new",
	b.color_cd 					as "产品颜色", 
	b.size_cd 					as "产品尺码", 
	gd.prd_line					AS	"系列",
	toString(gd.tag_price)				AS	"吊牌价",
	b.in_transit_inv_qty_bq  as "在途库存数量本期", 
    b.in_transit_inv_tag_amt_bq as "在途库存吊牌金额本期", 
	b.in_warehouse_inv_qty_bq as "在仓库存数量本期", 
	b.in_warehouse_inv_tag_amt_bq as "在仓库库存吊牌金额本期", 
	b.inv_qty_bq as "财务库存数量本期", 
	b.inv_tag_amt_bq as "财务库库存吊牌金额本期",
	b.in_transit_inv_qty_tq as "在途库存数量同期", 
	b.in_transit_inv_tag_amt_tq as "在途库存吊牌金额同期", 
	b.in_warehouse_inv_qty_tq as "在仓库存数量同期", 
	b.in_warehouse_inv_tag_amt_tq as "在仓库库存吊牌金额同期", 
	b.inv_qty_tq as "财务库存数量同期", 
	b.inv_tag_amt_tq as "财务库库存吊牌金额同期"

from (
select 
 maiadt, 
 caln_week, 
 caln_mon, 
 caln_quarter, 
 caln_year, 
 channel_brand_code, 
 channel_brand, 
 cms_code, 
 store_depot_code, 
 store_depot_name, 
 good_brand_code, 
 good_brand, 
 art_no, 
 color_cd, 
 size_cd, 
 sum(in_transit_inv_qty_bq) as in_transit_inv_qty_bq, 
 sum(in_transit_inv_tag_amt_bq)as in_transit_inv_tag_amt_bq, 
 sum(in_warehouse_inv_qty_bq) as in_warehouse_inv_qty_bq, 
 sum(in_warehouse_inv_tag_amt_bq)as in_warehouse_inv_tag_amt_bq, 
 sum(inv_qty_bq) as inv_qty_bq, 
 sum(inv_tag_amt_bq)as inv_tag_amt_bq,
 sum(in_transit_inv_qty_tq) as in_transit_inv_qty_tq, 
 sum(in_transit_inv_tag_amt_tq)as in_transit_inv_tag_amt_tq, 
 sum(in_warehouse_inv_qty_tq) as in_warehouse_inv_qty_tq, 
 sum(in_warehouse_inv_tag_amt_tq) as in_warehouse_inv_tag_amt_tq, 
 sum(inv_qty_tq) as inv_qty_tq, 
 sum(inv_tag_amt_tq)as inv_tag_amt_tq  from (
SELECT caln_dt as maiadt, 
caln_week, 
caln_mon, 
caln_quarter, 
caln_year, 
channel_brand_code, 
channel_brand, 
cms_code, 
store_depot_code, 
store_depot_name, 
good_brand_code, 
good_brand, 
art_no, 
color_cd, 
size_cd, 
in_transit_inv_qty as in_transit_inv_qty_bq, 
in_transit_inv_tag_amt as in_transit_inv_tag_amt_bq, 
in_warehouse_inv_qty as in_warehouse_inv_qty_bq, 
in_warehouse_inv_tag_amt as in_warehouse_inv_tag_amt_bq, 
inv_qty as inv_qty_bq, 
inv_tag_amt as inv_tag_amt_bq,
0 as in_transit_inv_qty_tq, 
0 as in_transit_inv_tag_amt_tq, 
0 as in_warehouse_inv_qty_tq, 
0 as in_warehouse_inv_tag_amt_tq, 
0 as inv_qty_tq, 
0 as inv_tag_amt_tq
FROM maia_pcbi.dm_maia_stock_day_sku_mi
where  caln_dt=[DYNAMIC_PARAMS.MAIA报表结束时间]
     --and ABS(in_warehouse_inv_qty)+ABS(in_transit_inv_qty)<>0
union all
SELECT addYears(caln_dt,1)as maiadt, 
caln_week, 
caln_mon, 
caln_quarter, 
caln_year, 
channel_brand_code, 
channel_brand, 
cms_code, 
store_depot_code, 
store_depot_name, 
good_brand_code, 
good_brand, 
art_no, 
color_cd, 
size_cd, 
0 as in_transit_inv_qty_bq, 
0 as in_transit_inv_tag_amt_bq, 
0 as in_warehouse_inv_qty_bq, 
0 as in_warehouse_inv_tag_amt_bq, 
0 as inv_qty_bq, 
0 as inv_tag_amt_bq,
in_transit_inv_qty as in_transit_inv_qty_tq, 
in_transit_inv_tag_amt as in_transit_inv_tag_amt_tq, 
in_warehouse_inv_qty as in_warehouse_inv_qty_tq, 
in_warehouse_inv_tag_amt as in_warehouse_inv_tag_amt_tq, 
inv_qty as inv_qty_tq, 
inv_tag_amt as inv_tag_amt_tq
FROM maia_pcbi.dm_maia_stock_day_sku_mi
where caln_dt=addYears(toDate([DYNAMIC_PARAMS.MAIA报表结束时间]), -1)
  --and ABS(in_warehouse_inv_qty)+ABS(in_transit_inv_qty)<>0
)a 
group by  maiadt, caln_week, caln_mon, caln_quarter, caln_year, channel_brand_code, channel_brand, 
cms_code, store_depot_code, store_depot_name, good_brand_code, good_brand, art_no, color_cd, size_cd
) b 
left join maia_pcbi.dm_maia_good_art_no_df gd on gd.art_no=b.art_no
left join maia_pcbi.dm_maia_store_info_df st on st.cms_code=b.cms_code

columns.name: 上市天数周期
columns.formula:
case  
when [上市天数]<=0 then '0' 
when [上市天数]>0 and [上市天数]<=7  then '7'
when [上市天数]>7 and [上市天数]<=15  then '15'
when [上市天数]>15 and [上市天数]<=30  then '30'
when [上市天数]>30 and [上市天数]<=45  then '45'
when [上市天数]>45 and [上市天数]<=60  then '60'
when [上市天数]>60 and [上市天数]<=90  then '90'
when [上市天数]>90 and [上市天数]<=120 then '120'
when [上市天数]>120 and [上市天数]<=150  then '150'
when [上市天数]>150 and [上市天数]<=180  then '180'
when [上市天数]>180 and [上市天数]<=360  then '360'
when [上市天数]>360 then '360天以上'
end
